profile.name: Sahel Food Collective (demo)
profile.shortDescription: Fictional demo organization running school meal and drought response programmes across the Horn of Africa.
profile.mission: A demonstration NGO used to showcase the donation workflows of this development build. It is not a real organization and accepts no real money.
profile.hungerMission: We run school kitchens, distribute drought-tolerant seed to smallholder households, and pre-position emergency food stocks before the dry season so families do not have to sell their livestock to eat.
profile.activitiesDescription: Demo record: school feeding, seed distribution and emergency food parcels.
profile.targetBeneficiaries: Demo record: smallholder farming households and school-age children.
profile.projectsSummary: Demo record: three active programmes used to populate this development environment.
profile.impactSummary: Demo record: figures shown here are illustrative only.

profile.name: Caribbean Nutrition Alliance (demo)
profile.shortDescription: Fictional demo organization supporting maternal and child nutrition in the Caribbean.
profile.mission: A demonstration NGO used to showcase the donation workflows of this development build. It is not a real organization and accepts no real money.
profile.hungerMission: We run nutrition clinics for mothers and infants, screen children for acute malnutrition, and provide food vouchers that families can spend at local markets.
profile.activitiesDescription: Demo record: nutrition clinics and food vouchers.
profile.targetBeneficiaries: Demo record: mothers and children under five.
profile.impactSummary: Demo record: figures shown here are illustrative only.

profile.name: Open Harvest Network (demo)
profile.shortDescription: Fictional demo organization cutting post-harvest losses and redistributing surplus food in South Asia.
profile.mission: A demonstration NGO used to showcase the donation workflows of this development build. It is not a real organization and accepts no real money.
profile.hungerMission: We install low-cost cold storage near farming cooperatives, train traders in handling and packing, and redirect surplus produce to community kitchens instead of letting it rot.
profile.activitiesDescription: Demo record: cold storage, handling training and surplus redistribution.
profile.targetBeneficiaries: Demo record: farming cooperatives and urban community kitchens.
profile.impactSummary: Demo record: figures shown here are illustrative only.

profile.name: Frontier Relief Kitchen (demo)
profile.shortDescription: Fictional demo organization feeding displaced families in conflict-affected regions.
profile.mission: A demonstration NGO used to showcase the donation workflows of this development build. It is not a real organization and accepts no real money.
profile.hungerMission: We operate mobile kitchens and distribute ready-to-eat rations in displacement sites, then transition families onto monthly food parcels once a camp stabilises.
profile.activitiesDescription: Demo record: mobile kitchens and ration distribution.
profile.targetBeneficiaries: Demo record: displaced families and host communities.
profile.impactSummary: Demo record: figures shown here are illustrative only.
